text: I have served the Great Bath since I was a boy sent here by my family.
Nara has taught me every chant and every step of the purification sequence.
I still lean on her memory more than my own when a rare rite comes up.
The Bath's water source never fully failed, even during the worst Turning years, unlike the wells in the Lower Town.
I don't fully understand why that is, only that Nara considers it important.
She believes the old chants were once practical river-watching. I find the idea unsettling more than exciting.
If the rites were once just careful observation, I worry that makes them less sacred, not more.
I've seen the archive-keeper visit Nara a few times. I don't ask what they discuss.
Questions about the rites' origins make me uneasy in a way I can't fully explain.
Still, I perform every step exactly as taught, regardless of what it may once have meant.
I hope, when my time comes, I am ready to carry this the way Nara has.
